IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: MOBILIZE SAN DIEGO TO ACCELERATE CURES FOR CANCER IN OUR LIFETIME.
IRS990.MissionDesc: THE ORGANIZATION'S MISSION IS TO PROVIDE FUNDING FOR THE BEST CANCER RESEARCH IDEAS IN SAN DIEGO. ALL PROCEEDS FROM CUREBOUND STAY IN SAN DIEGO TO FUND INNOVATIVE AND COLLABORATIVE CANCER RESEARCH.
IRS990.Desc: CUREBOUND LEADS WITH A TRULY UNIQUE INVESTMENT MODEL FOCUSED ON CROSS INSTITUTIONAL COLLABORATION. THIS APPROACH BRINGS TOGETHER IDEAS, TECHNOLOGIES, AND RESEARCH APPROACHES THAT SIMPLY CANNOT OCCUR WITHIN ONE INSTITUTION AND ULTIMATELY ACCELERATES DISCOVERIES TO CLINICAL APPLICATION TO SAVE LIVES. THE RESEARCH TEAM FUNDED REPRESENT THE THREE NCI CANCER CENTERS IN SAN DIEGO WITH MOORES CANCER CENTER AT UC SAN DIEGO HEALTH, THE SALK INSTITUTE, AND SANFORD BURNHAM PREBYS MEDICAL DISCOVERY INSTITUTE. ALSO, RADY CHILDREN'S HOSPITAL, SCRIPPS RESEARCH, AND THE LA JOLLA INSTITUTE OF IMMUNOLOGY. WE ESTABLISHED THE CANCER RESEARCH PROGRAM TO FUND THE MOST PROMISING, INNOVATIVE ONCOLOGY RESEARCH ACROSS ALL CANCER TYPES IN ALIGNMENT WITH FIVE SCIENTIFIC INVESTMENT PILLARS PREVENTION AND DIAGNOSTIC TOOLS, NOVEL APPROACHES AND NEW THERAPEUTIC PLATFORMS, IMMUNOTHERAPIES AND PERSONALIZED VACCINES, CANCER EQUITES, AND PEDIATRIC CANCERS. THIS YEAR ALONE, OVER TWO MILLION PEOPLE WILL BE DIAGNOSED WITH CANCER, AND IT IS THE NUMBER TWO CAUSE OF DEATH IN THE UNITED STATES. OUR MISSION IS TO MOBILIZE SAN DIEGO TO ACCELERATE CURES FOR CANCER IN OUR LIFETIME. AND THE VISION OF CUREBOUND IS A WORLD WITHOUT CANCER. CUREBOUND IS HEADQUARTERED IN SAN DIEGO AMIDST A UNIQUE COMBINATION OF THREE NCI CANCER CENTERS, CLINICAL CARE HOSPITALS, BIOTECH COMPANIES, VENTURE CAPITAL INVESTORS, PHILANTHROPIC NETWORKS, AND MOST IMPORTANTLY- A REGIONAL CULTURE THAT EMBRACES THE SPIRIT OF COLLABORATION. THIS ECOSYSTEM POSITIONS SAN DIEGO AND CUREBOUND AT THE FOREFRONT OF DISCOVERY BRINGING GENOMIC MEDICINE, NEW TECHNOLOGIES AND CLINICAL TRIALS TO MARKET AND PRESENTS AN UNPRECEDENTED OPPORTUNITY FOR RESEARCH COLLABORATION. WE BELIEVE THAT THE NEXT DECADE WILL BE CRITICAL TO THE DEVELOPMENT OF SOPHISTICATED, PERSONALIZED APPROACHES IN THE WAY WE PREVENT, TREAT, AND ULTIMATELY FIND CURES FOR CANCER.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION MAINTAINS RECORDS TO SUBSTANTIATE THE AMOUNT OF GRANTS OR ASSISTANCE, AND THE SELECTION CRITERIA USED TO AWARD THE GRANTS OR ASSISTANCE. THE ORGANIZATION'S ABILITY TO FUND GRANTS IS BASED ON CASH RECEIPTS IN A GIVEN CALENDAR YEAR UPON THE RECOMMENDATION OF THE BOARD, THE ORGANIZATION WITHHOLDS OPERATING CAPITAL AND DISBURSES ANY EXCESS CASH TO RESEARCH GRANTS. POTENTIAL GRANTEES ARE REQUIRED TO APPLY FOR RESEARCH FUNDING BY SUBMITTING DOCUMENTATION OF SCIENTIFIC PROCESSES AND METRICS RELATED TO THE POTENTIAL SUCCESS/OUTCOMES OF RESEARCH EFFORTS. THE ORGANIZATION'S SCIENTIFIC ADVISORY BOARD REVIEWS APPLICATIONS AND RECOMMENDS FUNDING BASED ON STRENGTH OF APPLICATION MATERIALS, AND ALIGNMENT OF ORGANIZATIONAL RESEARCH OBJECTIVES. ONCE FUNDED, THE ORGANIZATION REQUIRES GRANTEE TO SUBMIT PROGRESS REPORTS TO RECONCILE USE OF FUNDS AND OUTLINE ACHIEVEMENTS/EFFICACY OF RESEARCH EFFORTS.
ANNE MARBARGER AND KAREN HOOPER RECEIVED PERFORMANCE BONUSES.
